newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Surgical says wins Danek patent fight.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Surgical says wins Danek patent fight.

text.p: United States Surgical Corp said Thursday a federal district court judge in California had ruled in favor of one of its subsidiaries in a patent infringement suit that had been filed by Sofamor Danek Group Inc.

U.S. Surgical said U.S. District Court Judge George King of the Central District, California, ruled that its wholly owned subsidiary Surgical Dynamics Inc Ray Threaded Fusion Cage does not infringe a patent licensed by Sofamor Danek.
Surgical Dynamics had been sued by Sofamor Danek for patent infringement, U.S. Surgical said.
Sofamor Danek officials could not be reached for comment and no other details about the court decision were immediately available.
